title: Laguna governor denies wrongdoing in graft complaint over exam financial assistance

blocks.text: Laguna governor Sol Aragones on Monday denied wrongdoing in a graft complaint filed against her and several provincial officials over the alleged failure to follow proper procedures in distributing P15,500 in financial assistance to students preparing for professional examinations.
